about: Manual / robot steps for the GoLand 2026.2.3 reference (default Windows keymap) of tools/compare/refactor/scenarios.json. Open build/compare/prometheus (clean clone) as the project, wait for indexing. Place = the scenario's anchor + at (caret) or its 'select' text (selection). For every scenario first press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T (Refactor This) at the place and record the list, then Alt+Enter and record the list (Esc), then do the steps. After each scenario: record the diff (VCS | Local Changes / `git diff` + `git status --short` in the clone for created/deleted files), then Ctrl+Z until clean, or `git checkout -- . && git clean -fdq` in the clone, and File | Reload All from Disk. 'compare' says what to look at against the plugin's build/compare/out/refactor/<id>/diff.patch and gopls's refactor-gopls/<id>/diff.patch.
